title: Injectivity of residue-supported Frobenius-stable modules over regular local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof computes all Frobenius-power torsion layers using flatness of iterated Frobenius and shows these layers are free over truncated parameter quotients. It obtains parameter divisibility, then verifies Frobenius stability passes to parameter torsion and inducts on dimension. This is a distinct positive-characteristic classification task, not a parameter change of the derivation proof.
